title: THE BRIDGE OF DREAM // FOG ON THE RHOYNE
narrative: The Shy Maid drifted through a wall of impenetrable, milky fog that swallowed the stars. Rising from the mist were the colossal, moss-grown stone arches of Chroyane: the sunken palace city of Prince Garin the Great. The river was deathly silent, save for the dripping of slime from crumbling aqueducts. Suddenly, half-naked figures gray as slate dropped from the overhead arches with chilling silence: Stone Men, their flesh hardened to cracked granite by advanced greyscale, their milky eyes fixed upon Tyrion. The fog seemed to twist time itself, forcing the pole-boat to pass beneath the identical bridge three separate times.
resolvesPlotHole: The Temporal Distortion of the Bridge of Dream

options.text: Tyrion: Find tenderness with Penny in the hold of the Smelly Sow.
Jon Connington: Squeeze greyscale-hardened fingers around a sellsword hilt.
